messages:
Maya R.: Security advisory: new credential policy goes live next Friday. Two required actions: rotate internal long-lived tokens (>45d) and switch bastion access to PKI short-lived certs (ttl <=24h). Full guide: https://intranet.redwood/sec/credential-policy :warning:
Diego V.: Clarify scope: does this include staging and dev namespaces?
Maya R.: Yes. Any internal service account or automation in org namespaces that uses static tokens is in scope. Customer keys are out of scope.
infra-bot: secret-scan started: age>45d tokens (scope: eng).
Asha P.: Will the rotate helper produce an audit event we can reference for SOC?
Maya R.: Yes / rotate-helper returns a rotation_event_id and posts to audit-log endpoint. Save it in your changelog.
Ken L.: Ops will rotate ci-agent and model-sync tonight. Ping if we hit auth failures.
infra-bot: secret-scan complete: 12 items found. Report: https://ci.redwood/jobs/secret-audit/17768
Maya R.: Thanks team. Please ack here after you rotate and attach event IDs. If you need an extension, escalate to #eng-oncall with @Maya R. :lock:
